title: Acceptable Use Policy
summary: Governs use of company information systems by employees and contractors.
scope: All employees, contractors, and third parties granted access to company systems.

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.body: This policy establishes requirements for the acceptable use of information systems and data.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.body: Applies to all users of company systems including BYOD devices when used to access company resources.

clauses.text: Users must use MFA on all systems accepting it.
Users should not store confidential data on personal cloud storage.

sections.heading: Monitoring
sections.body: The company monitors system activity for security and legal compliance purposes. No expectation of privacy applies to work accounts.

sections.heading: Enforcement
sections.body: Violations may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination and legal action.

definitions.definition: Data classified as Internal-Confidential or higher per the Data Classification Policy.
Multi-factor authentication using at least two of: knowledge, possession, inherence.
